in_sanskrit.name: राजविक्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Rajvik' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'राज (Raj)' meaning 'ruler' and 'विक् (Vik)' meaning 'power/victory'. This name signifies a ruler who has the power and strength to achieve victory in all his endeavors.

in_hindi.name: राजविक
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Rajvik' in Hindi can be translated as 'the growth or development of a king'. It suggests a person who is destined to grow and prosper like a king in life.

in_tamil.name: ராஜ்விக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of 'Rajvik' is 'one who holds the kingdom firmly'. This name signifies a person who is strong, determined, and capable of ruling and protecting his domain.

in_telugu.name: రాజ్విక్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of 'Rajvik' is 'the lord of the kingdom'. It suggests a person who is powerful, respected, and in control of his surroundings.

in_marathi.name: Rajvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King, Ruler, Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj (king) + Vik (power, strength) = Rajvik (King of power)

in_bengali.name: Rajvik
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King, Ruler, Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajvik একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Raj (king) + Vik (power, strength) = Rajvik (King of power)
